# Codebase Overview

*Generated by /shipwithai-starter on 2026-05-28. Update when structure changes.*

## Entry points

| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `plugins/*/manifest.json` | Claude Code reads this to discover all skills in a plugin |
| `.claude-plugin/marketplace.json` | ShipWithAI marketplace registry |
| `.claude/settings.json` | Permission rules and safety hooks for this workspace |

## Key directories

| Directory | Purpose |
|-----------|---------|
| `plugins/` | One subdirectory per Claude Code plugin |
| `plugins/<name>/skills/` | One subdirectory per skill (SKILL.md + assets + references + evals) |
| `plugins/<name>/skills/<skill>/assets/` | Template files copied verbatim into user projects — handle with care |
| `plugins/<name>/skills/<skill>/references/` | Lazy-loaded reference docs (< 300 lines each) |
| `plugins/<name>/skills/<skill>/evals/` | evals.json with 5+ test prompts |
| `.claude/` | Harness: settings.json, agents/, memory/, hooks/ |
| `.claude/agents/` | Specialized sub-agents (drift-monitor) |
| `.claude/memory/` | Persistent project facts and team preferences |
| `.claude/hooks/` | Python safety hooks run on every Bash/Write tool use |
| `docs/` | Architecture, ADRs, CODEMAPS (this directory) |
| `docs/adr/` | Architecture Decision Records |
| `scripts/` | publish-plugin.sh — always confirm before running |

## Skill anatomy

```
plugins/<plugin-name>/
├── skills/<skill-name>/
│   ├── SKILL.md            ← loaded by Claude Code when skill is triggered (500-line cap)
│   ├── assets/             ← static templates written into user projects
│   ├── references/         ← loaded on-demand only (not at startup)
│   └── evals/evals.json    ← 5+ test prompts for validation
├── manifest.json           ← declares all skills; must stay in sync with skills/ directory
├── plugin.json             ← name, version, description
├── CHANGELOG.md            ← update on every release
└── README.md               ← live SSOT; update after every skill change
```

## Data flow

```
User types trigger phrase
  → Claude Code matches skill via manifest.json
  → SKILL.md content loaded as skill context
  → References loaded on-demand if skill calls for them
  → assets/ files written to user project if skill scaffolds code
```

## What NOT to edit manually

- `plugins/*/skills/*/assets/` — templates used verbatim in user projects; run evals after any change

## Sensitive areas

| Area | Why |
|------|-----|
| `manifest.json` | Out-of-sync with `skills/` causes missing or broken skills |
| `SKILL.md` | Published to users; 500-line hard cap; test on 2+ real projects before shipping |
| `.claude/hooks/` | Removing or breaking hooks disables safety guardrails for the whole workspace |
| `scripts/publish-plugin.sh` | Irreversible — always confirm before running |
